fields.title: The S&P 500 falls into a bear market by May 18, 2027
fields.text: The S&P 500 closes at or below 6,240 on any day through May 18, 2027: 20% or more below its October 2026 record close near 7,800. It closed at 7,323.63 on November 18 and fell about 1.9% on November 19.
